limitations: Planning grants no execution authority or capability claim.
Declared bounds and references are not verified enforcement.
Unknown revision stays unknown; aliases do not identify weights.
OpenAI F1 adapter ordering defect remains separately attributed; it cannot establish unsupportedness.
Native validity, canonical correlation and provider provenance remain separate observations.

Physical-attempt qualification applies only to the exact reviewed HTTP/1.1 sockets profile recorded per subject; HTTP/2, HTTP/3, proxies, redirects, authentication challenges and custom handler chains remain unsupported.
Decoded-byte ceilings are not wire-byte or preallocation bounds (S0-G6).
Provider-side billing semantics remain outside transport qualification; one physical inference attempt is a transport bound, not an exactly-once billing claim.

transport.physicalAttemptBoundBasis: http11-exact-post-with-content-no-expect-no-redirect-auth-cookie-proxy; SocketsHttpHandler runtime v10.0.12 only retries connection failures when HttpConnection._canRetry is true, which requires a contentless request or Expect: 100-continue after request headers were sent; version fallback and HTTP/2 stream-limit retry paths are unreachable for RequestVersionExact HTTP/1.1
